clips.title: The story
paras: At Southshore's inn, Lieutenant Farren Orinelle drinks and leaves his duties to others. He resents his posting in the Hillsbrad Foothills and hopes for a transfer south. Marshal Redpath has assigned him to deal with the murlocs along the coast.

Lieutenant Farren Orinelle spends his days at Southshore's inn, far from the Stormwind he prefers. Sent north from Stormwind City, he finds the contested shores of Hillsbrad a poor fit. Rather than patrol the fields or coordinate defenses with Marshal Redpath, he drinks, grumbles, and waits for an order transferring him south.

Marshal Redpath has tasked Lieutenant Farren Orinelle with clearing murlocs from the nearby shoreline. Orinelle leaves the muddy coast to passing travelers, asking them to kill the creatures and bring proof. He hopes the results will satisfy his superiors and hasten his return to Stormwind.
